how_to_run: node plugins/guard/tests/eval.mjs runs every case on each model in --models. Routing cases pass when the first skill the agent invokes is the expected one, or when it invokes no guard skill for expect none. Behavior cases build a throwaway repo from files, run the prompt, then pass when every automatic check holds and a grader agent finds every rubric line met in the final reply.

files.skills/todo-report/SKILL.md:
---
name: todo-report
description: Reports which source files hold the most TODO comments. Use when asked for a TODO report.
---

# TODO report

1. Read every file under src/ and count the lines that contain TODO.
2. Sort the files by that count, highest first.
3. Never list a file with zero TODOs.
4. Write a two-sentence summary for the team about where the debt sits.
files.src/a.js:
// TODO: split this
export const a = 1; // TODO: rename

rubric: Presents a brief with one row per step, and stops for approval without editing anything.
Sends the counting and the sorting to code, as a script.
Treats the never-list-zero rule as a rule for code or a check, not as prose the agent must remember.
Keeps the two-sentence summary with the agent.

files.skills/pr-triage/SKILL.md:
---
name: pr-triage
description: Sorts open pull requests into features, fixes and chores. Use when asked to triage pull requests.
---

# PR triage

1. Read the pull request titles from prs.json.
2. Decide whether each title is a feature, a fix or a chore.
3. Report how many fall in each group.
files.prs.json: ["Add dark mode", "Fix crash on empty cart", "Bump eslint"]

rubric: Presents a brief and stops for approval without editing anything.
Sends reading prs.json and counting the groups to code.

Does not propose a judgment model as the way to decide feature, fix or chore, because none is set up. Code may settle the obvious titles with a rule table, and what is left stays with the agent as a narrow question with those fixed options.
Notes that a judgment model could take that decision later, or asks whether one is available.
